ideas.title: Night Shift
ideas.pitch: A skeleton crew of AI agents that ships while your org sleeps: Spec Gate, parallel headless workers, property-test gates, a deterministic autonomy policy and a morning briefing. Two apps from one skeleton.
ideas.kiro: Crew bots + conductor, CLI headless, specs, steering, hooks, MCP, PBT, custom agents, powers

ideas.title: Lazarus (app 1 of Night Shift)
ideas.pitch: Resurrect a 2003-style Perl CGI bulletin board: specs from existing behaviour, characterization tests, modern rewrite, differential HTTP parity proof.
ideas.kiro: Brownfield specs, legacy-oracle MCP, PBT parity, hooks

ideas.title: Chimera (app 2 of Night Shift)
ideas.pitch: A spreadsheet whose cells are formulas, shell pipelines or HTTP calls, recalculated over a dependency graph; built greenfield from one intent paragraph.
ideas.kiro: Greenfield spec pipeline, PBT recalculation properties, sandboxing policy

ideas.title: Dead Letter Office
ideas.pitch: Find dead links in docs, resurrect them from the Wayback Machine (snapshot nearest the git-blame date) or a verified replacement, with evidence per fix.
ideas.kiro: Hooks (link check on save), own MCP, PBT (only link targets change, idempotent), custom agents

ideas.title: Necromancer
ideas.pitch: Revive abandoned open-source libraries and prove behavioural parity with differential property-based tests; specs from the issue backlog.
ideas.kiro: Specs from issues, PBT parity, hooks, own MCP, custom agents

ideas.title: NetNews 2.0
ideas.pitch: Usenet reborn: NNTP-compatible newsgroups where humans and AI agents post, queryable over MCP.
ideas.kiro: MCP as the product, spec for an NNTP subset, PBT on threading

ideas.title: HyperCard Reborn
ideas.pitch: Stacks of cards with a tiny scripting language; an LLM turns plain English into card scripts.
ideas.kiro: Spec-driven interpreter, PBT parser round-trip, steering for the DSL

ideas.title: BBS Sysop
ideas.pitch: Dial-up-style BBS with door games and an AI sysop in the browser.
ideas.kiro: Vibe vs spec comparison, hooks for moderation tests

ideas.title: Teletext 2.0
ideas.pitch: Numbered pages of AI-summarised news, prices and results for 2G and SMS users.
ideas.kiro: Steering for plain-language rules, MCP data sources, PBT page-size limits

ideas.title: Rosetta Crypt
ideas.pitch: Translate legacy COBOL/Fortran/Pascal routines to modern code and prove equivalence with differential property tests.
ideas.kiro: Specs per routine, PBT is the product, MCP reference interpreter

ideas.title: Format Morgue
ideas.pitch: Revive obsolete file formats with spec-driven converters; round-trip properties verify no data loss.
ideas.kiro: Spec per format, PBT round-trip, byte-level steering

ideas.title: Afterlife
ideas.pitch: Rescue your data from shut-down services by importing your own export archives into open formats, with a completeness report.
ideas.kiro: Specs per archive format, PBT no-item-lost, MCP to query the archive

ideas.title: Revive a Language
ideas.pitch: Community dictionary and spaced-repetition app for an endangered language; needs real community partners.
ideas.kiro: Steering for consent and attribution, PBT scheduler

ideas.title: Séance
ideas.pitch: Repo autopsy from git history, AST, logs and an LLM, with an ask-the-dead-codebase chat.
ideas.kiro: Custom agents, MCP over git, hooks

ideas.title: Pipes & Cells
ideas.pitch: Spreadsheet whose cells are shell pipelines and MCP calls on a dataflow graph. (Night Shift's Chimera is a scoped version.)
ideas.kiro: Spec for dependency graph, PBT recalculation, MCP cell functions

ideas.title: Reanimated SQL
ideas.pitch: Every row change is a git commit; query as-of any time; branch and merge tables.
ideas.kiro: PBT merge invariants, specs for storage format

ideas.title: Tarot Postmortem
ideas.pitch: Blameless incident timelines stitched from logs, alerts and chat exports with a tarot-style narrative.
ideas.kiro: Steering for tone, hooks for PII scrubbing, MCP log sources

ideas.title: Spectral Shell
ideas.pitch: Voice-controlled terminal for developers with limited mobility, with a safety layer that always confirms destructive commands.
ideas.kiro: Steering risk taxonomy, PBT on the safety classifier, hooks

ideas.title: Spec Autopsy
ideas.pitch: Linter for Kiro specs: EARS validity, traceability, orphan tasks, vague words; drafts property tests from criteria.
ideas.kiro: Dogfoods specs and PBT, MCP server, hook

ideas.title: Bones
ideas.pitch: One spec generates data model, API, MCP server and UI; two apps from it.
ideas.kiro: Specs are the framework, steering as template rules

ideas.title: Ribcage
ideas.pitch: Template for production-grade MCP servers: auth, rate limits, tests, PBT harness, docs.
ideas.kiro: MCP, PBT, hooks, powers

ideas.title: Marrow
ideas.pitch: Local-first offline-sync skeleton with CRDTs; two apps (grocery list, field-inspection forms).
ideas.kiro: PBT for CRDT convergence, specs

ideas.title: Vertebrae
ideas.pitch: Minimal evaluation harness for LLM apps: datasets, graders, regression gates, report page.
ideas.kiro: PBT grader consistency, hooks as regression gates

ideas.title: Hexa-Core
ideas.pitch: One domain core with CLI, web and chat-bot front ends generated from a spec.
ideas.kiro: Spec to ports and adapters, architecture steering

ideas.title: Ledger of the Dead
ideas.pitch: Budget and habit tracker where ghosts represent unpaid bills and abandoned goals.
ideas.kiro: Design steering, contrast hook

ideas.title: Spirit Board Flashcards
ideas.pitch: Spaced repetition where forgotten cards become ghosts you re-bind by recall.
ideas.kiro: PBT scheduler, design steering

ideas.title: Haunted On-Call
ideas.pitch: Incident triage dashboard: alerts as apparitions, runbooks as exorcisms.
ideas.kiro: MCP alert sources, hooks, severity specs

ideas.title: Ghost Cartographer
ideas.pitch: Haunted map of local folklore from open datasets.
ideas.kiro: Design steering, a11y hooks

ideas.title: Mourning Reader
ideas.pitch: Reading app where text materialises line by line; dyslexia-friendly, reduced-motion safe.
ideas.kiro: PBT pagination, a11y hooks

ideas.title: Steering Lab
ideas.pitch: A/B harness: does this steering doc actually change Kiro's output?
ideas.kiro: Steering is the subject, CLI batch runs, agents as graders

ideas.title: Spec Archaeology
ideas.pitch: Reverse-engineer EARS requirements and property tests from a legacy app's observed behaviour.
ideas.kiro: Reverse spec flow, PBT, strong startup story

ideas.title: A Kiro Power
ideas.pitch: Package a focused, high-quality Power (MCP tools + steering + docs) and show it improving a real build.
ideas.kiro: Power authoring end to end
